subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Sounds and Spelling – Unit 2, Lesson 2: ng
outcomes: I can hear ng at the end of words and say /ŋ/.
I can read and write ring, sing, long, swing and king.
I can read the tricky word their.

tf.s: The word ring ends with ng.
s - i - ng makes the word sing.
tf.why: Great! s - i - ng is sing.

tf.s: The word fork has ng in it.
tf.why: fork has or. ring has ng.

tf.s: We use their for other people.
tf.why: Yes! It is their torch means it belongs to them.

tf.s: We use their for me and my friends.
tf.why: For me and my friends we say our.

tf.s: The word king has ng at the end.
ng makes two sounds, n and g.
The word long starts with ng.
tf.why: ng comes at the end: l - o - ng.

boxes.q: Where is ng in these words?
boxes.why: ng comes at the end: ring, sing.

boxes.q: The last sound in ring is...
A man with a crown is a...
Which word does NOT have ng?

mcq.why: s - i - ng ends with ng.

mcq.q: Which is the new tricky word?
mcq.why: We learn their. our is revision.

mcq.q: How many sounds does ng make?
mcq.why: ng is two letters but one sound.

mcq.q: Where do we hear ng in our words?
mcq.why: ring, sing, king: ng is at the end.

mcq.q: Look at a picture of a king. Write the word.
Sara and Omar have a ball. It is ... ball.
Change s in sing to r. What word?
Which group has only ng words?
mcq.why: ring, long and bang all have ng.

mcq.q: What is the difference between our and their?
o: our is for us, their is for others
our is for others, their is for us

mcq.q: Which word is the odd one out?
mcq.why: storm has or. The others have ng.
